thesis.one_line: Faros traces every AI token to the work it produced and the outcome it shipped, so engineering orgs can make AI deliver quality and outcomes — not just speed or spend.
thesis.door: Spend — 'what did the AI bill buy?' (gets the meeting, credible with Finance).
thesis.room: Outcomes, quality, and a team that gets better (the real value; never argued as 'spend less').

pillars.name: Observe
pillars.summary: Trace AI work from tickets to outcomes to spend in one operational graph; every AI token tied to the work it produced at session, file, and decision grain.

pillars.name: Optimize
pillars.summary: Identify which models, workflows, and context produce the best outcomes; recommend models per task; generate repo-specific skills/rules that improve as outcomes feed back.

pillars.name: Govern
pillars.summary: Distributed context/policy kept in sync across repos; central policy; full provenance tying every shipped change back to spend, model, agent, and context.

capabilities.name: Token Attribution Ledger
capabilities.what_it_does: Ties every dollar of AI spend to the work it did and the outcome it shipped; classifies tokens as productive, inefficient, or wasteful.

capabilities.name: Engineering World Model
capabilities.what_it_does: A knowledge graph of how an org's teams build and deliver software; the substrate that joins tickets, sessions, PRs, deploys, incidents, and spend.

capabilities.name: Historical Replay
capabilities.what_it_does: Replays past PRs/tickets/sessions to learn what makes work succeed or fail, and to verify a change before recommending it.

capabilities.name: Model/Workflow Recommendations
capabilities.what_it_does: Recommends which model/tool fits a given task; flags where premium models add value vs. where cheaper ones match outcomes.

capabilities.name: Repo Skills & Rules Generation
capabilities.what_it_does: Generates skills, rules, and tools tailored to each repo so coding agents perform optimally; improves them each cycle.

capabilities.name: Negative Memory / Context Write-back
capabilities.what_it_does: Writes a failed session's lesson back into the repo's context so no agent — and no new engineer — repeats it.
capabilities.source: inference from Field Guide + demo design

capabilities.name: Policy & Compensating Controls
capabilities.what_it_does: Central policy; blocks banned models / missing required context; can require a compensating control (e.g. ship behind a feature flag) instead of hard-blocking.

capabilities.name: Provenance / Audit Trail
capabilities.what_it_does: Audit trail tying every shipped change back to the spend, model, agent, and context that produced it, from the original ticket.

solutions.name: AI Transformation
solutions.promise: Turn AI experimentation into systematic, measurable AI engineering.

solutions.name: Delivery Excellence
solutions.for_whom: Eng leaders running delivery at scale
solutions.promise: Visibility + control over how work progresses, with enforceable workflows and policy.

proof.claim: ~30% increase in GitHub Copilot adoption; improved lead/delivery times.
Reporting that took hours/days now available in one dashboard in minutes.
95% of enterprise AI shows no measurable P&L impact — a learning gap, not model quality.
